current.text: He re-signed with Minnesota for 3 years and 10 million USD.
Minnesota has moved to smaller, guard-heavy lineups and is short on size and wing depth.
He could get minutes when Minnesota goes to small lineups.
With his projected bench role and low output, he is not a draft target in a 12-team league.
With a March 28 end, Minnesota plays 4, 2 and 4 games in our playoff weeks, so the semifinal week has only two games. The team has the league minimum of 13 back-to-backs.

durable.text: He is a very good defender who adds steals and little else.
He plays like an undersized power forward and works as a cutter in the dunker spot.
His scoring is far below the top 250 pool, so he gives almost nothing in points.
